correctness.rationale: The 14-vertex graph and admissibility quantifiers are explicit. An executable exhaustive check reconstructs all 478 nonempty faces, pairs 450 of them in 225 Hasse-cover pairs, checks every one of 1610 directed incidences, and topologically sorts all 478 nodes, proving acyclicity. Critical cells are exactly one vertex, 21 edges and six tetrahedra. Forman discrete Morse yields a CW with only dimensions 0,1,3; its 3-cell maps into the graph 1-skeleton are null since \(\pi_2\) of a graph vanishes. Thus the integral homotopy type is the stated sphere wedge, including torsion-freeness. Exact modular boundary rank checks over four primes independently corroborate, but are not substituted for, the proof.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical smallest cubic girth-six cage and Fano incidence graph. Its all-faces geodesic general-position complex is not a preselected arbitrary slice: the complete homotopy type detects a separated 21-circle and six-three-sphere structure, invisible from maximum-set sizes and face-vector Euler characteristics. A finite exact, nontrivial homotopy classification is a natural reusable test case for general-position topology on incidence geometries; no wider family claim is needed.
